reviewer: independent evaluator; direct FID 506 GIS snapshot/layer metadata, first-party project/residences pages, three Studio M photographs, two renders, and Blender 5.2.3 direct reopen

criteria.status: FID 506 is an explicit Building F candidate, but the feature is pre-planning and the as-built identity/wall line is unverified
evidence: Purdue Campus Map FeatureServer layer 0 FID 506 is named Building F (BLDG_ABBR 143; Building_F field 4000-WHFS-1509). Its layer attribute is 'BLDG Building Pre-planning', BUILDING_1 is '1509', while ADDRESS is blank, NUM_LEVELS is 0, and BUILT/OCCUPIED are null.

The 32-vertex model base ring matches this FID 506 polygon after inverse Web Mercator and the repository's campus projection to 0.000059 m maximum vertex residual. This verifies reproduction of the candidate geometry, not that the pre-planning polygon is the as-built Building F wall line.

The Purdue Residences page confirms Provenance as the apartment community, and Studio M's project page confirms the development and seven three-story buildings, but neither source cross-identifies this GIS polygon as the completed individual Building F.
findings: Treat FID 506 as a candidate only; a current as-built campus footprint or identifiable Building F address/elevation is needed to verify the selected individual building and wall registration.

criteria.status: campus coordinates and dimensions match the direct GIS candidate; physical as-built registration remains uncertain
evidence: Direct Blender reopen bounds are X -1573.270..-1523.543 m, Y -466.864..-447.562 m, and Z 0.000..11.400 m. The transformed FID 506 candidate envelope is 49.73 m by 19.28 m.

The single mesh retains campus-world coordinates and identity transform, and its shell ring reproduces the candidate polygon at sub-millimetre numerical error. The uncertainty is upstream in whether the pre-planning polygon represents the as-built footprint, rather than in the Blender transformation.
findings: Validate the candidate position/orientation/dimensions against current orthophoto or as-built survey before treating them as verified for the completed building.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.status: three-story character and repeated gables are supported at project level; building-specific dimensions are estimates
evidence: Studio M's project description states that the Provenance development has seven three-story apartment buildings; project photographs show repeated gabled roofs. This supports the general storey count and roof vocabulary but does not assign an elevation or exact gable sequence to FID 506.
The model uses estimated 8.9 m wall/eave and 11.4 m ridge heights. The Purdue FID 506 record itself has NUM_LEVELS=0 and Extrution=0, so it provides no height measurement.
findings: Keep wall and ridge heights and the five-segment roof layout labeled as estimates; no Building F section, survey, or individually attributable roof image is present.

criteria.status: project material palette and repeated gables are recognizable; individual facade composition is generalized
evidence: Studio M images show a three-story apartment facade with brick, dark framed windows, balconies, dark vertical accent bays/panels, and repeated gabled roof masses. The secondary project material description supports brick and dark panel/cherry finishes, though those finishes are not assigned to individual FID 506 elevations.

The southwest render conveys a long three-story brick block with repeated roof breaks and windows, but the facade is highly schematic: no balconies, entrances, canopy/door details, or clear dark accent panels are visible; window placement and gable-to-facade correspondence are not attributable to this individual building. The top preview is useful for plan inspection but does not add facade evidence.
findings: The model's facades lack prominent visible elements in the official project photographs, especially balconies, framed glazing, dark accent bays, and identifiable entries. Building-specific reference imagery is needed before assigning exact arrangement.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.status: saved library and evidence reopen cleanly; shared manifest bounds still describe the superseded proxy
evidence: Blender 5.2.3 LTS reopened scene Building_massing_provenance_apartments_005_960f6b0 and collection Asset_massing_provenance_apartments_005_960f6b0 with one mesh (684 vertices, 458 faces), no modifiers, 0 unpacked image dependencies, and 0 linked Blender libraries.

The audit folder includes the raw official FID 506 feature and layer metadata, source register, project/residences snapshots, three project photographs, two previews, build evidence, and a separate-process reopen validation.

The shared manifest still declares bounds [[-1627.371337890625, -1489.2232666015625], [-474.5072326660156, -446.1253967285156], [0.0, 11.399999618530273]]; reopened geometry bounds are [[-1573.270263671875, -1523.542724609375], [-466.8640441894531, -447.56170654296875], [0.0, 11.399999618530273]]. This mismatch is up to 54.10 m and shows that the coordinator-owned manifest was not reconciled with the rebuilt candidate asset. The asset itself and dedicated evidence are portable.
findings: Coordinator should reconcile the shared manifest bounds with the rebuilt asset after independent source identity/footprint review.

recommendation: The asset scores 6.1/10 and does not pass the 8/10 gate.
